Mettmann bei Düsseldorf · Ab sofort · Unbefristete Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Tageweise Homeoffice möglich

Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung von Photovoltaikanlagen und möchtest Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der ersten technischen Auslegung bis zur ausführungsreifen Montageplanung begleiten? Bei ErEne erstellst du die Planungen vor der Auftragserteilung und bereitest nach Beauftragung die vollständigen DC- und AC-Montagemappen für unsere Montageteams vor.

Wir sind die ErEne Green Technologies GmbH. Seit 2010 sind wir auf die Installation und den Vertrieb von Photovoltaik- und Energiespeichersystemen spezialisiert. Von unserem Standort in Mettmann aus betreuen wir private, gewerbliche und kommunale Kunden. Für unser Team suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fachplaner, der unsere PV-Projekte selbstständig plant und eng mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung und Montage zusammenarbeitet.

Deine Aufgaben

Technische Planung vor der Auftragserteilung

  • Du prüfst die technische Machbarkeit unserer Projekte und planst Photovoltaikanlagen, Speichersysteme und Ladeinfrastruktur.

  • Du erstellst Anlagenkonzepte, erste Modulbelegungspläne sowie Ertrags- und Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen.

  • Du wählst geeignete Komponenten aus, bewertest technische Risiken und klärst offene Fragen mit dem Vertrieb, der Projektleitung und Lieferanten.

  • Du erstellst Angebote und Richtangebote in unserem ERP-System und unterstützt bei der technischen Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen.

Ausführungsplanung und Montagevorbereitung

  • Du überführst die abgestimmte Angebotsplanung in eine vollständige, nachvollziehbare Ausführungsplanung.

  • Du erstellst die DC-Montagemappen, insbesondere mit Modulbelegungs- und Stringplänen, Leitungsführung sowie den erforderlichen Komponenten- und Montageangaben.

  • Du erstellst die AC-Montagemappen, einschließlich Anschluss- und Stromlaufplänen, Kabeldimensionierung sowie Mess- und Schutzkonzepten.

  • Du berücksichtigst die Einbindung von Wechselrichtern, Speichern und Ladeinfrastruktur und stimmst technische Anforderungen mit Netzbetreibern und Lieferanten ab.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass die Planungsunterlagen vollständig, widerspruchsfrei und für unsere Montageteams verständlich sind.

Technische Begleitung der Umsetzung

  • Du übergibst deine Planung an Projektleitung und Montage und klärst Rückfragen zur Ausführung.

  • Du arbeitest erforderliche Änderungen ein und hältst die Planungsunterlagen aktuell.

  • Du berücksichtigst die für das jeweilige Projekt geltenden gesetzlichen Vorgaben, Normen und technischen Anschlussbedingungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine elektrotechnische Qualifikation, beispielsweise als Elektrotechniker, Elektrotechnikmeister oder Elektroingenieur, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung, Projektierung und/oder Abwicklung von Photovoltaikprojekten sowie praktische Erfahrung in der eigenständigen technischen Planung.

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in der DC- und AC-Planung: Du kannst aus den Projektanforderungen eine technisch schlüssige Auslegung und ausführungsreife Unterlagen erstellen.

  • Erfahrung mit Modulbelegungs- und Stringplanung, Kabeldimensionierung sowie Mess- und Schutzkonzepten.

  • Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Normen und Anschlussregeln für PV-Anlagen, insbesondere der für unsere Projekte relevanten Anforderungen an Nieder- und gegebenenfalls Mittelspannungsanschlüsse.

  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit PV*SOL, CAD-Software und MS Office.

  • Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und effiziente Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

Du übernimmst die fachliche Planung selbstständig. In unsere internen Abläufe, das ERP-System und die Struktur unserer Planungs- und Montageunterlagen arbeiten wir dich gezielt ein.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du begleitest die technische Planung von der Angebotsphase bis zur Umsetzung auf der Baustelle.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Abstimmungswege mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung und Montage.

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive: Unbefristete Festanstellung mit Gestaltungsspielraum und persönlichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gleitzeit und die Möglichkeit, tageweise im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

  • Ausstattung und Mobilität: Firmenhandy und Firmenwagen.

Deine Mission

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Du führst ein kleines Team fachlich und steuerst Arbeitspakete, Ergebnisse, Termine und Fortschritt.

  • Du erarbeitest gemeinsam mit dem technischen Projektleiter und den Architekten das Gesamtkonzept und baust tiefes Systemwissen auf, idealerweise inklusive grundlegender HF-Messungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Multi-Board-Architektur und die Schnittstellen zwischen Hard- und Software sowie die Anbindung des HF-Frontends an den Digitalteil.

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von Hardware, Firmware und Software und bereitest fundierte Architekturentscheidungen vor.

  • Du verantwortest die Geräteintegration und -verifikation und stimmst die Meilensteine mit den beteiligten Teams und der Teilprojektleitung Produktion ab.

  • Du erstellst und pflegst Produktbeschreibungen, Testverfahren und Datenblätter und steuerst die gerätebezogenen Quality Gates.

  • Du bewertest Aufwand, Machbarkeit und Risiken und informierst den technischen Projektleiter sowie bei Termin-, Budgetabweichungen oder Eskalationen die Gesamtprojektleitung.

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung.

  • Erfahrung in Multi-Board- und Plattformarchitekturen bringst du ebenso mit wie Kenntnisse in High-Speed-Analog-/Digital-Frontends bis ca. 50 Gbit/s.

  • Du verstehst die Architektur von FPGA, SoC, ADC/DAC und Schnittstellen wie JESD204B und kannst Systemdesigns bewerten.

  • FPGA-, ARM- und Power-Management-Kenntnisse ermöglichen dir die fachliche Steuerung von Firmware und Schnittstellen.

  • Mit Schnittstellendokumentation (ICD), Geräteintegration, Verifikation und Quality Gates bist du vertraut.

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, entwickelst digitale Architekturen auch bei offenen Anforderungen und bewertest Machbarkeit, Aufwand und Risiken analytisch.

  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich

Das bieten wir Dir

Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass folgende Rahmenbedingungen die besten Voraussetzungen für Effizienz und kreative Lösungsfindungen bieten:

  • Aktives Mitwirken an innovativen Zukunftstechnologien

Do you enjoy connecting with new people, opening doors and turning opportunities into business? Do you get excited about exploring international markets, testing new ideas and shaping how a company grows? Are you ready to take ownership beyond traditional outbound sales?

As an International Sales Development Representative at Building Radar, you will play a key role in driving our international expansion. You'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, build high-quality sales pipeline and help shape our go-to-market strategy across new markets.

This role goes beyond traditional sales development. You'll combine hands-on outbound sales with market research, strategic experimentation and the freedom to turn your own ideas into measurable results.

If you already have some experience in SDR, BDR or go-to-market roles, enjoy taking initiative and want to make a real impact on international growth, we'd love to meet you.

Your mission

Drive International Outbound Sales: Identify high-potential companies across international markets, find key decision-makers and engage them through personalized outreach via phone, email and LinkedIn.

Build & Qualify Pipeline: Understand prospects' challenges, business goals and buying signals. Turn meaningful conversations into qualified opportunities and high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

Shape Our Go-to-Market Strategy: Explore new markets, customer segments and outreach approaches. Test messaging, analyze results and help build scalable outbound playbooks that accelerate international growth.

Own Your Initiatives: Take responsibility for your own campaigns and market development activities. Spot opportunities, experiment with new approaches and drive your ideas from concept to measurable pipeline impact.

Create Messaging That Converts: Develop compelling outreach sequences, sales materials and personalized messaging that resonate with different industries, markets and decision-makers.

Leverage Data, AI & Sales Tools: Use CRM systems, sales automation and AI-powered tools to optimize prospecting, improve workflows and make our outbound efforts smarter and more effective.

Your profile

First SDR / GTM Experience: You already have hands-on experience in sales development, business development or a comparable go-to-market role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Experience with international prospecting, cross-border outbound or developing new markets is a strong plus.

Strong Communication Skills: You know how to engage prospects, ask the right questions and communicate value clearly. Fluent English is essential; German or another European language is a plus.

Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take initiative, identify opportunities and enjoy turning ideas into action. You're comfortable taking ownership of your work and learning from results.

Strategic Curiosity: You're interested in understanding different markets, customer needs and buying behaviors. You enjoy using data and insights to improve your approach.

Outbound Confidence: You're comfortable reaching out to new prospects, handling objections and building relationships. You understand the fundamentals of structured outbound sales and know how to create opportunities from first conversations.

Growth Mindset & Ownership: You're eager to develop your skills, open to feedback and motivated to take on increasing responsibility as our international business grows.

Why us?

Our Sales-Team:

At Building Radar, our Sales Team is at the forefront of connecting innovative technology with the people who can benefit from it. You'll engage with industry leaders, uncover their challenges and help them discover new ways to drive revenue through smarter sales processes.

As an International SDR, you won't just follow an existing playbook. You'll help improve it. You'll work closely with our Account Executives and Sales Team to explore international opportunities, exchange market insights and develop outbound approaches that deliver results. You'll have the opportunity to sharpen your sales skills while gaining hands-on experience in international go-to-market strategy, market development and sales technology.

Why Building Radar?

Shape the Revolution: Work with cutting-edge technology to drive the digital transformation of the construction industry and leave a lasting impact.

Worldwide Vibes: Join a highly motivated team of professionals from over 11 nations – we believe global diversity fuels creativity and innovation.

Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy the perfect balance of team spirit in our office and the flexibility of working from home.

Unlimited Vacation: We prioritize trust over control. Take the time you need to recharge and return with fresh ideas to tackle new challenges.

Investing in Your Future (VWL): We support your long-term wealth building with up to €40/month (for full-time, permanent employees) paid directly into a savings plan of your choice.

Financial Incentives: In addition to a fair base salary, we reward your success through variable compensation and special bonuses.

Development Budget: We invest in your growth! You receive an annual development budget of €1,000 for training, tools, and professional courses.

Cool Events: From mountain weekends and Oktoberfest visits to off-sites and go-kart racing – we believe in celebrating our success together.

Sport is our Passion: Use our in-house gym or benefit from our EGYM Wellpass subsidy (we cover over 50%) to stay fit and healthy.

You’ll Never Walk Alone: To ensure a smooth start, our Buddy Program pairs you with an experienced mentor during your onboarding.

Referral Program: Help us grow! For every successful referral of a friend or acquaintance, you can earn a bonus of up to €2,000.

Actura übernimmt operative Führungsfunktionen in Krankenhäusern und Reha-Kliniken. Unser Anspruch: Umsetzung statt Beratung. Dafür suchen wir erfahrene IT-Führungskräfte, die bei unseren Kunden die IT-Leitung übernehmen und dauerhaft Teil der Klinik werden.

Der Einstieg erfolgt oft in einer besonderen Lage: eine unbesetzte IT-Leitung, die Neuaufstellung nach einem Cyberangriff, die Vorbereitung auf NIS2- und KRITIS-Prüfungen, ein KIS-Wechsel oder die Integration nach einem Trägerwechsel. Du schaffst Klarheit, führst das Team und baust eine IT auf, die dauerhaft trägt.

Dein Job: Führen, wo es zählt.

  • Du übernimmst als IT-Leitung die Verantwortung für IT-Betrieb, Team, Budget und Dienstleister beim Kunden

  • Du verschaffst Dir in den ersten Wochen ein klares Lagebild und entwickelst mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Strategie mit belastbarem Maßnahmenplan

  • Du führst und entwickelst das interne IT-Team, steuerst externe Partner und ordnest Verträge und Leistungen neu, wo es nötig ist

  • Du verantwortest Informationssicherheit und Compliance: ISMS, NIS2, KRITIS und B3S, Meldewesen, Datenschutz und Prüfungen

  • Du treibst die großen Themen: KIS-Wechsel, Rechenzentrums- und Cloudmigration, Telematikinfrastruktur, Digitalisierung und KHZG

  • Du berichtest an Geschäftsführung und Gremien und arbeitest eng mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und den klinischen Bereichen zusammen

  • Du baust Strukturen, Prozesse und Dokumentation so auf, dass die IT dauerhaft stabil und prüfungssicher läuft

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

  • Du hast mehrjährige Führungserfahrung als IT-Leiter oder in vergleichbarer Verantwortung, idealerweise im Krankenhaus oder Gesundheitswesen

  • Du bringst breites IT-Fachwissen mit: Infrastruktur, Netzwerk und Security genauso wie klinische Applikationen (KIS, PACS, Medizintechnik-Anbindung)

  • Du kennst die regulatorischen Anforderungen an Kliniken (NIS2, BSIG und KRITIS, B3S, DSGVO) und hast Audits und Prüfungen verantwortet

  • Du hast Budget- und Vertragsverantwortung getragen und verhandelst souverän mit Lieferanten

  • Du findest Dich schnell in neue Organisationen ein, entscheidest klar und gewinnst das Vertrauen von Geschäftsführung, Ärzten und Pflege

  • Du kommunizierst verständlich, setzt Dich mit Augenmaß durch und behältst auch in Krisen die Ruhe

  • Du willst langfristig gestalten und bringst Dich vor Ort voll in die Klinik ein

Gute Gründe für Actura.

Umsetzung statt Beratung.
Du trägst Verantwortung und setzt selbst um. Keine Folienschlachten, sondern Ergebnisse im Haus.

Von Kliniken für Kliniken.
Ein Netzwerk aus Praktikern für Prozess, Personal, Controlling und IT, das den Krankenhausalltag kennt.

Perspektive.
Eine langfristige Aufgabe beim Kunden, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Actura mit aufzubauen.

Lust auf IT-Leitung mit Wirkung?

Dann bring Deine Erfahrung dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird und dauerhaft wirkt. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

data.description:
Über die Prokuras Gruppe

Prokuras ist eine deutschlandweit agierende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich des Immobilien- und Gebäudemanagements. Bundesweit gehören inzwischen mehr als 500 Mitarbeitende zu den Unternehmen der Prokuras Gruppe. Seit Gründung im Jahr 2023 sind wir durch die Umsetzung von Nachfolgesituation und Wachstumspartnerschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-and-Build Strategie stetig gewachsen.

Als in der Hansestadt Hamburg ansässige Holding-Gesellschaft unterstützen wir die Unternehmen unserer Gruppe und deren Mitarbeitende bei der Bewältigung ihrer alltäglichen großen wie auch kleinen Herausforderungen.
Unser modernes Büro liegt direkt neben den Hamburger Deichtorhallen, vis-à-vis der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten digital, flexibel und standortübergreifend. Gleichzeitig setzen wir auf persönlichen Austausch, kurze Wege und die Möglichkeit, Dinge unkompliziert voranzubringen.

Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern moderne Technologien aktiv mitgestalten? Du interessierst dich für Microsoft 365, künstliche Intelligenz und digitale Innovationen und möchtest erleben, wie diese Werkzeuge in einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe eingesetzt werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Als Werkstudent IT & KI (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, den Einsatz moderner Technologien in unserer Unternehmensgruppe weiter voranzutreiben. Von Microsoft 365 über Copilot bis hin zu digitalen Prozessen und Automatisierungen arbeitest du an Themen mit, die den Arbeitsalltag unserer Mitarbeitenden nachhaltig verbessern. Dabei lernst du unterschiedliche IT-Themen kennen, arbeitest an konkreten Projekten mit und kannst Schritt für Schritt eigene Verantwortung übernehmen.

Funktion und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Microsoft 365 & digitale Zusammenarbeit: Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung und hilfst dabei, digitale Arbeitsprozesse einfacher, effizienter und nutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten. Dabei lernst du moderne Anwendungen wie Microsoft Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive kennen und unterstützt deren Einsatz im Unternehmensalltag
  • KI & Microsoft Copilot: Du probierst neue KI-Tools aus, unterstützt bei der Einführung und Nutzung von Microsoft Copilot und identifizierst konkrete Anwendungsfälle, die unseren Teams den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern. Dabei analysierst du bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für KI-gestützte Lösungen und hilfst dabei, neue Möglichkeiten für den sinnvollen Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz in unserer Unternehmensgruppe zu erschließen
  • IT-Support im Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden und Partnerunternehmen bei technischen Fragestellungen und trägst dazu bei, digitale Arbeitsplätze zuverlässig und effizient bereitzustellen. Dabei lernst du unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Systeme kennen und entwickelst dein technisches Wissen kontinuierlich weiter
  • Benutzer- und Geräteverwaltung: Du wirkst bei der Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen und Endgeräten sowie bei der Bereitstellung von Hard- und Software mit. Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in moderne Cloud- und Identitätsmanagement-Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-365-Umgebung
  • IT-Projekte & Prozessoptimierung: Du arbeitest an konkreten IT-, Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsprojekten mit, bringst eigene Ideen ein und unterstützt dabei, neue Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu begleiten. Dazu gehören beispielsweise die Optimierung bestehender Arbeitsabläufe, die Einführung neuer digitaler Werkzeuge sowie die Entwicklung KI-gestützter Prozesse
  • Dokumentation & Wissensaufbau: Du dokumentierst Lösungen und Prozesse verständlich und trägst dazu bei, IT-Wissen im Team und in der Unternehmensgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Dabei lernst du, technische Zusammenhänge strukturiert aufzubereiten und Wissen verständlich weiterzugeben

data.description:
ÜBER NEOLYMP

NEOLYMP ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Aufgaben

WARUM DIESE ROLLE

  • Du bestimmst, was gebaut wird: Angles, Hooks, Konzepte, Funnel-Logik – du entscheidest, welche Creatives entstehen und warum. Das Grafikteam setzt um, was du konzipierst.
  • Direkter Hebel auf Umsatz: Deine Konzepte laufen auf Meta und weiteren Paid-Kanälen, auf Landingpages und im Shop. Was du testest, siehst du in ROAS, CTR und Conversion Rate – nicht in Quartalsberichten.
  • Führung mit Substanz: Du leitest ein Grafikteam, das Video und Statics in-house produziert, und gestaltest, wie dieses Team arbeitet, wächst und besser wird.
  • Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong: Research, Konzept, Briefing, Produktion, Test, Iteration – die gesamte Kette liegt bei uns im Haus. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Performance, Shopify-Entwicklung und Creator-Management.
  • Eine Marke, die noch Spielraum hat: Wir sind groß genug für echte Budgets und klein genug, dass deine Handschrift Sichtbar wird.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Strategie & Konzeption

  • Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere Performance-Kanäle (insbesondere Meta) und unseren Onlineshop – von der übergeordneten Creative-Roadmap bis zum einzelnen Ad-Konzept.
  • Du konzipierst Angles, Hooks und Formate auf Basis von Zielgruppen-Insights, Awareness-Stufen und Wettbewerbsanalysen und baust daraus eine systematische Testing-Pipeline.
  • Du entwickelst und optimierst Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten konzeptionell – Aufbau, Argumentation,Einwandbehandlung – gemeinsam mit unserem Shopify Manager.
  • Du setzt die komplette content-gesteuerte Seite unserer Sales-Events auf: Dramaturgie, Creative-Konzepte, Landingpages, Timing über alle Kanäle hinweg.

Research & Positionierung

  • Du führst Produkt- und Zielgruppen-Research durch: Wer kauft, warum, mit welchen Einwänden – und wie sprechen wir diese Menschen an?
  • Du entwickelst die Positionierung unserer Produkte und entscheidest, an wen wir welches Produkt mit welchem Angle richten.
  • Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerb und Plattform-Trends und übersetzt sie in konkrete Content-Hypothesen.

Teamführung & Briefing

  • Du führst unser Grafikteam fachlich und disziplinarisch, setzt Prioritäten, gibst klares Feedback und entwickelst die Menschen in deinem Team weiter.
  • Du schreibst präzise Creative-Briefings – mit Zielgruppe, Angle, Hook, Referenzen und Erfolgskriterien – und sorgst für eine Produktion, die schnell, strukturiert und qualitativ hochwertig läuft.
  • Du koordinierst mit Creator-Management und Shooting-Planung, welcher Content produziert werden muss, damit deine Konzepte umsetzbar sind.

Analyse & Iteration

  • Du analysierst die Performance von Creatives und Landingpages gemeinsam mit dem Performance-Team und leitest daraus Learnings, Iterationen und neue Konzepte ab.
  • Du baust eine Wissensbasis auf: Was funktioniert bei welcher Zielgruppe, welche Hooks tragen, welche Formate skalieren.

Qualifikation

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Scaling von Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta (und idealerweise TikTok, Google oder YouTube) – du hast Creatives konzipiert, die mit relevantem Budget profitabel gelaufen sind, und kannst darüber konkret sprechen.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Team oder Kreativschaffende geführt, kennst den Unterschied zwischen Anweisung und Entwicklung und weißt, wie man ein Team gleichzeitig fordert und hält.
  • Tiefes Verständnis für Direct-Response-Prinzipien, Awareness-Stufen, Hook-Mechaniken und Funnel-Psychologie – du kannst erklären, warum ein Creative funktioniert, nicht nur dass es funktioniert.
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Landingpages, Funnel-Seiten oder Sales-Events im E-Commerce / D2C.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Starke Research-Kompetenz: Du arbeitest mit Kundeninterviews, Reviews, Umfragen, Wettbewerbs- und Ad-Library- Analysen und ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse.
  • Datenkompetenz: Du liest ROAS, CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CPA und Conversion Rate sicher und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.
  • Exzellente Briefing- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit – schriftlich wie mündlich, mit Designer:innen genauso wie mit Performance-Marketern.
  • Ein Blick für Gestaltung: Du musst nicht selbst schneiden, aber du erkennst, ob ein Creative dein Konzept trifft.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung – du wartest nicht auf Vorgaben, du machst Vorschläge.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung im Fitness-, Sport- oder Health-Bereich.
  • Erfahrung mit UGC- und Creator-Content in der Performance-Produktion.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in Research, Ideation oder Creative-Produktion.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo oder Amazon-Marketing.
  • Wir suchen für diese Rolle bewusst ein starkes Profil – jemanden, der schon unter Beweis gestellt hat, was hier erwartet wird. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du berichtest direkt an den Head of E-Commerce und arbeitest mit eigener Personalverantwortung selbstständig und frei.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Munich, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's Digital Native customers across the DACH region. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Munich or Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

  • Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Europe, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

  • Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

  • Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

  • Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices.

  • Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises.

  • Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.

  • Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact.

  • Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers.

  • Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements.

  • Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Are comfortable leading across DACH and partnering across European markets from Munich, adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models.

  • Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership.

  • Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI.

About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are seeking a Device Reliability Testing Engineer to drive reliability qualification, failure analysis, and accelerated life testing for our integrated graphene photonics products. In close collaboration with Design Enablement, Process Integration, and Product Quality, you will establish robust test methodologies to validate device reliability, and long-term stability in accordance with industry standards.

You will play a key role in transitioning our technology from prototype to production- qualified products, ensuring that graphene photonics meet the performance and robustness requirements of high-volume deployment.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

  • Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

  • Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

  • Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

  • Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

Your Qualifications

  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or Photonics Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in semiconductor device physics, optoelectronics, or reliability engineering

  • Hands-on experience in photonic device characterization and reliability testing

  • Experience with high-speed RF testing (>40 GHz) and VNA-based S- parameter measurements.

  • Experience with advanced test equipment such as VNA, real-time and sampling oscilloscopes (50+ GHz), lightwave component analyzers (LCA), optical spectrum analyzers, and probe stations.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who.

What you will achieve in your first 12 months

  • You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

  • You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.


What the job really looks like

  • A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

  • You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.


What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

  • Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

  • Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

  • Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.


What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.


Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

  3. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the Platform Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

In the Platform Engineering team, you will build the next generation of the internal developer platform behind Spread Group's core services - a cloud-native platform on AWS, designed from the ground up. We see our platform as a product and our developers as our customers.

This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one

  • Design and build platform services, APIs and self-service capabilities that let teams build, deploy and operate their core services end-to-end

  • Provide "golden paths": standardized templates, pipelines and building blocks that get teams to production quickly and safely

  • Build and evolve the AWS cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, including Kubernetes and managed services

  • Keep the platform secure, reliable and cost-efficient

  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience

  • Maintain the existing on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes landscape - keeping all services reliably running while the migration to AWS is underway

  • Guide the migration of roughly 175 existing services onto the new platform

What You´ll Bring

  • Several years of professional experience (mid-level to senior) in software engineering, ideally in platform engineering, SRE or DevOps - a computer science degree is welcome but not required

  • Solid experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

  • In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, Linux and containers

  • Strong software engineering skills - you write production-grade code in a language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, building platform services and APIs, not just infrastructure scripts

  • Experience designing REST APIs

  • Solid Git skills and knowledge of platform services such as CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI) and observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)

  • A product mindset - you see developers as the customers of your work

  • Good communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GitOps (e.g., Argo CD) and secrets management (e.g., Vault)

  • Experience with internal developer portals (e.g., Backstage)

  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

data.description:
ennovationHUB is an expanding international e-commerce group specialising in the home & living sector, with furniture at the core of our offering. Through our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers throughout the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC.

As we work towards €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are seeking a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us as soon as possible. You will lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, taking direct responsibility for revenue growth, advertising efficiency, and profitability.

About the opportunity:

You will be part of an international business operating multiple e-commerce brands, with substantial advertising investment across several markets. Working at this scale means your decisions will directly influence revenue and commercial results.

Google Ads already plays a significant role in our growth. We are looking for someone who enjoys navigating international e-commerce, working with large datasets, and uncovering opportunities that deliver measurable improvements.

Working alongside our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will use analysis, experimentation, and hands-on optimisation to develop this established channel further. Your focus will be on maintaining strong current performance while supporting efficient growth over time.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Own Google Ads performance across international markets for one of our e-commerce brands

  • Run and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats

  • Monitor and improve core performance measures, including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Drive growth and improve advertising efficiency across your assigned portfolio

  • Uncover opportunities within product ranges, categories, markets, and audience groups

  • Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and practical next steps

  • Conduct account reviews and introduce continuous performance improvements

  • Work with developers and analytics colleagues to maintain accurate tracking and reliable measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to strengthen advertising effectiveness and landing page results

  • Contribute to budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay informed about platform updates, AI-powered advertising capabilities, and industry best practices

  • Help develop structured tests and experiments that strengthen account performance over time

The impact you can make:

Our Google Ads campaigns already generate results. You will build on that foundation by uncovering further opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling successful approaches.

In a competitive e-commerce environment, even small improvements can make a significant commercial difference. You will connect campaign decisions to business outcomes and remain accountable for their impact.

You will collaborate with experienced colleagues who work quickly and place a high value on execution. We welcome independent judgment, evidence-based decisions, and constructive questions about existing approaches. You will have the trust to make decisions and directly support the company’s growth.


In-house e-commerce experience is a requirement for this position. Candidates whose Google Ads experience is primarily gained through agencies, consultancy, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for someone who has owned performance within an e-commerce company, with results evaluated through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustained growth.

You should understand how campaign performance connects to wider commercial goals and be comfortable taking responsibility for both decision-making and implementation.

What you will bring:

  • A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • A proven record of managing Google Ads within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability

  • Extensive practical knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team

  • The ability to analyse large datasets and identify opportunities that can be put into practice

  • A solid grasp of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Working familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Strong analytical skills and a thorough approach to detail

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • The ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • A curious, proactive approach and a commitment to ongoing improvement

  • Confidence operating independently, making decisions, and owning the results

  • A readiness to use AI and automation as we continue introducing them across the business

  • Availability to start immediately or as soon as possible

Your working style:

You bring senior-level judgment while staying actively involved in campaign execution and performance. You draw clear conclusions from data and translate those findings into practical action.

You want to understand what drives results and regularly look for ways to improve them. You can move comfortably between longer-term planning and daily optimisation while keeping business growth and commercial outcomes in focus.

You enjoy developing and scaling campaigns, accepting responsibility for their performance, and helping an established channel continue to grow.

International collaboration and travel:

Our team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. As the company grows, we are continuing to invest in our team presence.

The role includes travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations. These visits provide time for joint planning, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions.

Most work takes place remotely, complemented by regular opportunities to collaborate and plan together in person as the business scales.

This is a long-term opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the growth of an international e-commerce group.

Our culture at ennovationHUB:

We value:

  • Taking ownership and following through on commitments

  • Turning plans into action

  • Communicating clearly and directly

  • Building knowledge through hands-on experience

We welcome people from different backgrounds who care about the quality of their work, take responsibility for their contribution, and help the business progress.

data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

 

Your Tasks

  • You will maintain and continuously improve recurring reports, providing management with clear daily and weekly updates on key developments

  • You will conduct advanced data analyses, primarily using Excel, to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities across the sales funnel

  • You will leverage data-driven insights to optimize internal and external processes, workflows, and operational efficiency

  • You will build clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards that enable stakeholders to understand data and independently work with reporting tools

  • You will support the team with recurring operational tasks, including data preparation, ad-hoc analyses, reporting updates, and handling stakeholder requests

 

Your Profile

  • You are currently pursuing or have completed a degree in Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field

  • You have strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data to identify patterns, derive insights, and solve business problems

  • You have advanced knowledge of Excel and are comfortable working with large datasets and complex analyses

  • You have a structured, detail-oriented working style and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

  • You are proactive, curious, and motivated to improve processes and contribute to operational excellence

  • You have experience with SQL, BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker), or data visualization tools, which is a plus

  • You are fluent in English; German or other languages are a plus

Are you interested in the role but don’t meet all requirements? Apply anyway! We are excited to discover your potential, regardless of whether your experience matches every single requirement. ☀️

 

Your Benefits

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

data.company_name: Senior Software Engineer, Gamified Security Awareness (Full-Stack)
data.description:
Our mission and why it matters

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

Why this role matters

The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area.

What you’ll own and drive

You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps.

What success looks like

• In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps.

• By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota.

What makes you thrive here

You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. • Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team.

• High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety.

• Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on.

• A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth.

• The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany.

To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We cannot process applications sent via other channels, such as email or LinkedIn messages.

Today we are a global team of +300 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc.

As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. We don't just educate employees through frequent, personalized, and behavior-changing cybersecurity training - we also actively build real threat intelligence and response tools that protect organizations against malicious cyberattacks every single day.

We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

DAS UNTERNEHMEN

Unser Mandant ist eine etablierte Organisation der kritischen Infrastruktur im Ruhrgebiet.

Das Unternehmen steht für hohe Versorgungsrelevanz, komplexe Betriebsstrukturen und einen starken gesellschaftlichen Auftrag. Mehrere tausend Mitarbeitende tragen täglich zur Stabilität und Sicherheit zentraler Dienstleistungen bei.

Aktuell befindet sich die Organisation in einer Phase erhöhter Anforderungen an:

  • Cyber-Resilienz und Informationssicherheit
  • regulatorische Compliance (u. a. KRITIS, NIS2)
  • Digitalisierung geschäftskritischer Prozesse
  • Professionalisierung von Governance-Strukturen

Informationssicherheit ist dabei ein zentraler Bestandteil der Unternehmensstrategie und gewinnt zunehmend an Bedeutung auf Geschäftsleitungsebene.


DIE HERAUSFORDERUNG
Der Informationssicherheitsbeauftragte (ISB) übernimmt die zentrale Verantwortung für den Aufbau, die Weiterentwicklung und die nachhaltige Verankerung der Informationssicherheit im Unternehmen.
 
Zu den Kernaufgaben gehören:
  • Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des ISMS (z. B. nach ISO 27001 / BSI-Grundschutz)
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen im KRITIS-Umfeld
  • Beratung von Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften in sicherheitsrelevanten Fragestellungen
  • Durchführung von Risikoanalysen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen
  • Sensibilisierung und Schulung der Organisation im Bereich Informationssicherheit
  • Koordination von Audits sowie Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Prüfinstanzen
  • Schnittstellenmanagement zu IT, Datenschutz, Compliance und operativen Einheiten
    • Der Kontext ist geprägt von:
  • hoher regulatorischer Dynamik
  • steigender Bedrohungslage im Cyberraum
  • gewachsenen IT- und Prozesslandschaften
  • Spannungsfeld zwischen Sicherheit, Betrieb und Wirtschaftlichkeit
  • zunehmender strategischer Relevanz von Informationssicherheit

    • IHR PROFIL
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Informationssicherheit, idealerweise als ISB oder in vergleichbarer Funktion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und Regularien (z. B. ISO 27001, BSI, NIS2, KRITIS)
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystemen
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht aufzubereiten – vom operativen Bereich bis zur Geschäftsleitung
  • Strukturierte, analytische und risikoorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Souveränes Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern oder Organisationen mit kritischer Infrastruktur ist von Vorteil.

    • WAS DIE ROLLE BESONDERS MACHT
    Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, Informationssicherheit nicht nur operativ umzusetzen, sondern strategisch zu gestalten.

  • Sicherheit als integralen Bestandteil der Organisation verankert

data.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

 

Our Tech Stack includes: 

  • AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js, using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka.

What we offer 🎁

A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability
The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up
The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities 
Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association
Significant investment in your learning and growth
Competitive compensation and benefits package (i.e 28 days of paid time off)

Research indicates that people from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities—often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every single requirement.

At Vestiaire Collective, we believe that talent comes in many forms, and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Your unique perspective could be exactly what our team needs, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every box.

Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunities employer
