Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business, from the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events and best-selling console games. We also own the world's largest streaming guide, giving us unique insights into audience behaviours and content tastes.

From a small startup, we've evolved into a team of more than 200 people, based in Berlin, around the world or working remotely. We've built a profitable business while continuing to grow.

Who we need

We are looking for a Senior Growth Analyst with at least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics. You will support growth across JustWatch TV and our streaming guide, with the main focus on JustWatch TV.

You will partner with our marketing, campaign, product and Business Intelligence teams to understand which acquisition activity brings valuable users, improve confidence in measurement and testing, and turn findings into budget and campaign decisions.




What you will be doing
  • Analyse user acquisition performance across channels, markets and audiences, and recommend where to scale, adjust or stop spending.

  • Develop our attribution approach and interpret MMP and ad platform reporting. Work with BI and technical teams to define conversion events, validate tracking and resolve data discrepancies. You will lead analytical requirements and validation; technical teams own implementation.

  • Analyse acquisition cohorts, activation, retention, subscription conversion and revenue alongside LTV, CAC, ROAS and payback periods. Make assumptions explicit and use findings to guide acquisition and bidding targets.

  • Design and evaluate A/B tests, holdouts and incrementality tests with the marketing team. Distinguish attributed conversions from incremental impact and turn findings into practical recommendations.

  • Build benchmarks, forecasts, dashboards and efficient reporting to guide planning, budgets and growth targets, working with BI to keep KPI definitions consistent and data reliable.

  • Support selected client campaign analyses and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, prioritising work that improves decisions and performance.


    • What we need from you

  • Essential experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics, ideally in an app, subscription or digital consumer business.

  • A strong understanding of mobile analytics, including attribution, conversion events, measurement limitations and discrepancies between data sources.

  • An understanding of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, TikTok and Google, their optimisation goals and performance metrics.

  • Experience analysing acquisition funnels, retention cohorts and unit economics to assess user value beyond installs or initial conversions.

  • Confident working with spreadsheets, BI tools and data from multiple sources.

  • The ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions constructively and prioritise independently.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

    • Useful extras

  • Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.

  • Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, holdouts or incrementality tests.

  • SQL or Python.

  • Experience with CTV app measurement, ASO or CRM and lifecycle analytics.

  • German language skills.


    • What we offer you

  • An open-minded, international team that enjoys collaborating to reach shared goals.

  • Meaningful work, opportunities for personal growth and the chance to make a lasting impact.

  • A permission-less environment where you can take ownership and focus on delivering value without unnecessary complexity.

  • Trust in your expertise and judgement, with room to improve how we work and bring new ideas.

  • A collaborative and supportive environment that helps you achieve your personal and professional goals.

  • A flexible hybrid working environment, with no requirement to come to the office.

    • Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality. 
     
    If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:
    • A company culture that really works
    • Audience as a Service
    • Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

    How to apply

    Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

    Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

    If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

    Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Mit Packa haben wir die erste End-to-End SaaS-Plattform für intelligentes Verpackungsmanagement gebaut – stark nachgefragt, exzellent finanziert und rasant wachsend.

  • Du bist ein:e Netzwerker:in. Du steuerst souverän komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse, überzeugst unterschiedlichste Stakeholder und agierst flexibel und wirkungsvoll – intern und extern.
  • Du bist unser:e Sparringspartner:in. Du entwickelst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiter und identifizierst gezielt Up- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale, um einen langfristigen Kundenerfolg sicherzustellen.

    • Was du mitbringst
  • Du bist ein Sales-Profi. Mit mindestens 3 Jahren Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise als Account Executive oder im Account Management – verstehst du, wie man komplexe Vertriebszyklen erfolgreich steuert und Abschlüsse mit Substanz erzielt.
  • Du beherrschst Saas – technisch und vertrieblich. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Saas-Vertrieb mit und weißt, wie man komplexe Saas-Produkte zielgerichtet und überzeugend am Markt positioniert.
  • Du bist ein:e Macher:in mit Umsetzungsstärke. Du gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an, handelst eigenverantwortlich und verfügst über die Ausdauer und den Ehrgeiz, auch in neuen Situationen Wirkung zu erzielen.
  • Du überzeugst mit klarer Kommunikation und Demo-Kompetenz. Du präsentierst komplexe Funktionen verständlich, richtest den Fokus konsequent auf den Kundennutzen und gewinnst unterschiedliche Stakeholder durch zielgerichtete Argumentation.
  • Du bist ein:e kommunikationsstark – in Deutsch und Englisch. Du bewegst dich sicher auf Entscheider-Ebene, formulierst klar und präzise und überzeugst sowohl Einkaufsverantwortliche als auch Geschäftsführungen.

  • Du bist ein:e Roadwarrior:in. Reisen ist für dich selbstverständlich - du bist bereit, im Zwei-Wochen-Rhythmus vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu sein und repräsentierst Packa auch persönlich mit Professionalität und Wirkung.

Wir freuen uns immer darauf, einzigartige Kandidaten kennenzulernen, also zöger bitte nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wir stellen auch nach Einstellung, Werten und Persönlichkeit ein und würden gerne unsere Fähigkeiten gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln. 
     
    Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! :)
     
    Bei Packmatic schätzen wir Vielfalt! Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungschancen ein, unabhängig von deinem Geschlecht, deiner Religion, deinem Alter, deiner sexuellen Orientierung, deiner ethnischen Zugehörigkeit, deiner Behinderung oder deiner Herkunft. Wir kümmern uns um einander und sind dankbar für den Beitrag jedes Einzelnen zu unserer Mission!
     
     
    Über Packmatic:
    Wir sind dabei, den Verpackungsmarkt neu zu denken. Wir schaffen Lösungen, um die Verpackungsindustrie ins digitale Zeitalter zu führen und ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck zu verbessern.
     
    Unsere Lösung kommt bei unseren Kunden so gut an, dass wir wöchentlich 40-50 Anfragen bekommen und wir kürzlich eine Series A Runde über 15 Mio. von führenden VCs eingesammelt haben. Wenn du genauso motiviert bist wie wir, eine der größten B2B-Branchen weltweit zu modernisieren und in einem superschnell wachsenden digitalen Start-up im Herzens Berlins echten Einfluss zu haben, bist du bei uns am richtigen Ort. 
     
    Wir haben die Verpackungsbeschaffung zahlreicher zufriedener SME & Enterprise Kunden digitalisiert und ihnen dabei geholfen, viele Tonnen Plastik einzusparen - aber das ist erst der Anfang.

data.description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and fostering creative, fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Controlling Manager who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with senior leadership across Brand & Marketing, Product, Sourcing, B2B and Marketplace, your focus will be on driving financial transparency, strengthening data-driven decision-making, and shaping the financial performance of our product brands and sales channels. In this role, you will combine your strategic financial expertise with your ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders and drive continuous improvement across the Finance function.


What you will do
  • Lead and further develop a high-performing Controlling team of four in Germany, ensuring a strong link between team objectives and corporate strategy.
  • Own and develop the financial controlling of the product brands, including margin transparency, pricing analytics, product profitability and financial performance reviews of Marketing activities.
  • Act as a strategic business partner to senior leadership and the B2B and Marketplace teams, providing actionable insights to support profitable growth, financial planning and operational excellence.
  • Support the FP&A Director and team with budgeting, forecasting, reliable actuals, variance analysis and weekly and monthly business reviews, while contributing to scalable reporting and forecasting through Pigment.
  • Drive improvements in financial data, dashboards, automation and AI-supported analytics, while leading critical Finance projects as required, including systems-focused and other strategic initiatives.

    • What you should bring
  • Several years of experience in Controlling, ideally within an international or multi-brand environment.
  • Proven leadership experience, with the ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong expertise in margin analysis and performance steering.
  • Experience with modern ERP and BI systems (e.g. NetSuite, BigQuery, Superset, Power BI, Pigment) and evidence of driving change.
  • Advanced analytical skills and experience working with complex datasets, digital FP&A processes and automated reporting, ideally including AI-driven analytics tools.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
  • Degree in Finance, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

    • What we can offer you
    • A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
    • Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.

    • Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
    • Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
    • Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.

    • Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
    • Hiring Manager Interview
    • Hiring Team Interview
    • Leadership Interview

    Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

    If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

    At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

    We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

The Practical Detail
Location: Hamburg, Germany
Working model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will activate Flora Food Group's global nutrition science materials locally, ensuring they resonate with healthcare professionals and consumers in your market. This role is vital for translating complex nutrition science into clear, credible messages that support product development, marketing, and communication. You will be the trusted nutrition business partner on the ground, connecting global insights with local needs to strengthen our nutrition leadership. Your work helps shape how our products meet real nutritional needs, making better food accessible and understandable in kitchens and healthcare settings.

What you'll do

  • Activate and adapt global nutrition strategies and materials for local markets, ensuring relevance and accuracy for healthcare professionals and consumers.
  • Monitor local nutrition science developments, media coverage, and competitor activity to provide timely insights to the global nutrition team.
  • Build strong partnerships with marketing, sales, communications, and other internal teams to embed nutrition expertise across the business.
  • Deliver internal nutrition education and training to enhance local team knowledge and capability.
  • Represent Flora Food Group at local conferences and events, communicating our nutrition messages with confidence and clarity.

Performance
You will own the local execution of global nutrition science initiatives, ensuring consistent application of nutrition standards and evidence-based communication. Your data-driven insights and proactive approach will improve decision-making and strengthen our market position. Success will be measured by the effective local activation of nutrition materials, stakeholder engagement, and the quality of nutrition guidance provided.

Care
This role reports to the global nutrition team and works closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, communications, regulatory affairs, and product development. You will foster collaboration and accountability, ensuring nutrition science is applied responsibly and sustainably. Your long-term focus will help build a trusted nutrition foundation that supports both consumer health and business growth.

Passion
You are a food lover and nutrition enthusiast who thrives on translating science into practical, meaningful messages. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and food functionality drives you to raise the bar in how nutrition benefits are communicated. You take pride in being a credible, approachable expert who inspires confidence in both internal teams and external partners.

About you
You hold a Master's degree in Nutrition, are a Registered Dietitian, or have a related qualification. You are fluent in German in writing and speaking and preferably bring experience working with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in Germany, with a strong understanding of how the local HCP network operates. Your experience includes applied nutrition science within the food industry, ideally in fast-moving consumer goods. You bring strong skills in nutrition data analysis, standards application, and regulatory frameworks. You communicate complex nutrition science clearly and adapt your style to diverse audiences. You are a proactive self-starter who works autonomously, builds strong relationships, and confidently manages stakeholder expectations.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role offers a clear path to senior nutrition positions within Flora Food Group or opportunities to move into local cross functions. There is also potential for mobility within the global nutrition team, allowing you to broaden your impact and expertise over time.

About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value.

As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement.

Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes.

 

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:

 Customer Technical Adoption 

  • Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship.
  • Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives.
  • Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives.
  • Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case.
  • Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. 

Product Expertise 

  • Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems.
  • Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap.
  • Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem.
  • Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.

 Industry Expertise 

  • Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields.
  • Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities.
  • Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc.
  • Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise.
  • Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams.
  • Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences.
  • Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives.
  • Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred.
  • Python programming skills is a plus.
  • Broad knowledge of the SaaS industrial analytics ecosystem is a plus (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, AVEVA, Aspen Tech, IOTA, Cognite, C3.ai, Palantir, etc.).

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

data.description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

  • Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
  • Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
  • Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
  • Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
  • Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
  • Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
  • Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.

Was du mitbringst

  • Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
  • Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
  • Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
  • Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
  • Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
  • Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
  • Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.

Was wir dir geben

  • Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
  • Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
  • Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
  • Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
  • Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
  • Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on public sector and defence accounts in Europe, particularly in Germany. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Ministries, Agencies, and defence organisations across Europe. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government and defence engagements.

Location: Germany

Eligibility: This individual must be a German citizen living in Germany and fluent in German, enabling immediate engagement with critical defense and national security customers.

Security Clearance: German security clearance is not required, but is a strong nice-to-have.

What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

  • Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Germany and broader European public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

  • Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

  • Translate complex public sector and defence requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

  • Navigate complex procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

  • Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, pubic sector and defence leadership

  • Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

  • Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior stakeholders including departmental executives

  • Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

  • Create and manage project schedules that account for public sector and defence timelines, security review processes, and approval cycles

  • Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

  • Navigate risks unique to government and defence deployments: privacy compliance, security, political and regulatory, technology and infrastructure.

  • Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific customer requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

  • Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

  • Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

  • Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government and defence deployments

  • Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

  • Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers.

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

  • Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

  • Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

  • Deep understanding of how government and defence organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

  • Familiarity with European government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

  • Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

  • Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

  • Eligible to obtain a German security clearance

Nice to Have:

  • Active German security clearance

  • Bilingual (English/German) proficiency

  • Background in or strong familiarity with European defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

  • Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

  • Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

This role strongly prefers eligibility for German government security clearance.

We are looking for candidates eligible for German government clearance, meaning that they require German citizenship. In addition, this individual is required to be based in Germany and be fluent in German as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers.

What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management - it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Wieso praxipal?

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Der Austausch findet bei uns ganz selbstverständlich über Teamgrenzen hinweg statt – im Alltag wirst du dabei vor allem mit Julius, Lisa und Daniel eng zusammenarbeiten.

Wonach wir suchen

  • 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, inklusive der Verantwortung für den kompletten Customer Lifecycle (Onboarding bis Renewal)

  • Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Detailgenauigkeit

  • Klare, überzeugende und empathische Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Datengetriebene Denkweise: Über Kennzahlen und Analysen Entscheidungen treffen und Kunden proaktiv steuern

In einem Satz: du begleitest Praxen bei der Einführung unserer KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Nutzung und treibst den kommerziellen Erfolg voran

  • Du führst (Remote-) Onboardings mit Ärzten und Praxisteams durch

Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

 

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

  • Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment

  • Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

  • 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products

  • Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus

  • Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike

  • Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements

  • Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making

  • Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product

  • Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath

  • Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget

  • Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile ("we" or "us") is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates' data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. California residents have additional rights under the CCPA, including the right to know, delete, and correct personal information.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology".

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

(Senior) Penetration Tester / Red Teamer (m/w/d)

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Offensive Security: Du führst eigenständig Penetrationstests durch, identifizierst Schwachstellen in komplexen IT-Landschaften und analysierst Angriffswege über Netzwerk-, System- und Anwendungsebenen hinweg

  • Realistische Angriffssimulation: Du stellst Sicherheitsketten eines Unternehmens im Rahmen von Advanced Cyber Attacks und Red Teaming Assessments auf die Probe

  • Technisches Consulting: Du berätst unsere Kunden herstellerunabhängig zu modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen, Angriffsszenarien und Best Practices und führst Audits / Whitebox-Reviews mit technischem Schwerpunkt durch

  • Analyse & Reporting: Du bereitest technische Ergebnisse zielgruppengerecht auf, machst komplexe Angriffe verständlich und leitest daraus konkrete, umsetzbare Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden ab

  • Research & Development: Du wirkst aktiv bei der Entwicklung neuer Angriffstechniken, Tools, Automatisierungen und Infrastruktur mit

  • Gemeinsame Expertise: Du wirst Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams, in dem jeder seine Spezialgebiete einbringt und gemeinsam zum Erfolg des gesamten Teams beiträgt

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security mit Fokus auf Penetration Testing und/oder Red Teaming

  • Technisches Know-how: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Entra-ID, Enterprise-Netzwerken und/oder Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure etc.)

  • OT/ICS-Erfahrung: Praktische Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Assessments in kritischen OT-/ICS-Umgebungen sowie in der Bewertung von Risiken und Ableitung pragmatischer Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der Cyber-Resilienz

  • Development Skills: Programmiererfahrung, idealerweise in Python, Go, Java, oder C#

  • Mindset: Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst neue Perspektiven in komplexe Security-Herausforderungen ein („think outside the box“)

  • Kommunikation: Du hast Freude an der Beratung, bringst technische Inhalte klar auf den Punkt und kannst sie sowohl Fachteams als auch dem Management verständlich vermitteln

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und analytisch, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und lieferst eigenständig Ergebnisse auf hohem Niveau

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von rund 30 % mit. Dazu gehören gelegentlich auch internationale Reisen

  • Nice to have: Zertifizierungen wie OSCP, OSWA/OSWE, CRTO, SANS oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen

Was Dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

Über SAJ:

SAJ ist ein globaler Hersteller und Innovator von intelligenten Energiespeicherlösungen. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2005 bietet das Unternehmen zudem fortschrittliche Produkte in den Bereichen Stromerzeugung und Industrieautomation. Unter dem Leitgedanken „Technologiegetrieben und serviceorientiert“ deckt SAJ die komplette Wertschöpfungskette von der Forschung und Entwicklung (F&E) über die Produktion bis hin zu Betrieb und Service ab. Mit einer erfolgreichen Lokalisierungsstrategie und Präsenz in über 80 Ländern verfolgt das Unternehmen das klare Ziel, die weltweit führende Marke der Branche zu werden und durch sichere, zuverlässige Technologien aktiv eine grüne Zukunft mitzugestalten.

SAJ是一家全球性的智能储能解决方案制造商和创新者，成立于2005年，提供智能储能、发电及工业自动化产品和解决方案。秉承“技术驱动，服务引领”的理念，SAJ构建了涵盖研发、生产、运营和服务的全价值链体系，致力于成为全球领先的智能储能品牌。目前，SAJ采取本地化营销策略，业务遍及德国、意大利、西班牙、英国、比利时、荷兰、澳大利亚、巴西等80多个国家和地区。未来，SAJ将持续为全球市场提供智能、安全、可靠的储能解决方案，共建绿色未来，成就美好生活。

Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Weiterentwicklung des technischen Supports für die DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz), einschließlich der Festlegung von Prioritäten, Servicestandards und Arbeitsabläufen für das regionale Supportteam.

  • Führung, Coaching und Unterstützung der technischen Supportingenieure, einschließlich Aufgabenverteilung, Kompetenzentwicklung, Leistungsfeedback und technischer Schulungen.

  • Verantwortung für das Eskalationsmanagement bei komplexen Kunden- und Produktproblemen sowie Sicherstellung einer zeitnahen Ursachenanalyse, klaren Kommunikation und wirksamen Problemlösung.

  • Definition und Überwachung von Service-KPIs, Reaktionszeiten und Problemtrends sowie datenbasierte Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit, Teameffizienz und Supportqualität.

  • Technische Unterstützung auf Expertenniveau im Pre- und After-Sales für Vertriebsmanager, Distributoren, Installateure, EPC-Unternehmen und Schlüsselkunden, einschließlich Produktauswahl, Systemkonfiguration, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Fehlerbehebung.

  • Aufbau und Pflege enger technischer Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßige Besprechungen, Vor-Ort-Besuche und Projektunterstützung.

  • Planung und Durchführung von Produkteinführungen, technischen Schulungen, Webinaren, Workshops und Kundenveranstaltungen in der DACH-Region.

  • Erfassung und Weitergabe von Kundenanforderungen, Marktfeedback und wiederkehrenden technischen Problemen an das Produktmanagement und die Forschung und Entwicklung sowie Nachverfolgung der daraus abgeleiteten Maßnahmen.

  • Koordination lokaler Produkttests und Validierungen, einschließlich Firmware-, Software-, Kompatibilitäts- und Systemintegrationstests.

  • Entwicklung und Pflege von technischen Supportprozessen, Wissensdatenbanken, Handbüchern, FAQs, Leitfäden zur Fehlerbehebung und Schulungsunterlagen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Service sowie Forschung und Entwicklung zur Sicherstellung einheitlicher technischer Lösungen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen.

岗位职责

  • 领导并发展DACH区域（德国、奥地利和瑞士）的技术支持业务，为区域支持团队明确工作优先级、服务标准及工作流程。

  • 管理、指导并支持技术支持工程师，包括工作任务分配、能力培养、绩效反馈及技术培训。

  • 负责复杂客户及产品问题的升级处理，确保及时开展根因分析、清晰沟通并有效解决问题。

  • 建立并监控服务关键绩效指标（KPI）、响应时间及问题趋势，通过数据提升客户满意度、团队效率及技术支持质量。

  • 为销售经理、分销商、安装商、EPC承包商及重点客户提供高级别售前和售后技术支持，包括产品选型、系统配置、安装、调试及故障排查。

  • 通过定期会议、现场拜访及项目支持，与重点客户建立并维护稳固的技术合作关系。

  • 策划并开展DACH区域的新品发布、技术培训、线上研讨会、工作坊及客户活动。

  • 收集客户需求、市场反馈及反复出现的技术问题，向产品及研发团队反馈，并推动后续措施落实。

  • 协调本地产品测试与验证，包括固件、软件、兼容性及系统集成测试。

  • 建立并维护技术支持流程、知识库、手册、常见问题解答、故障排查指南及培训资料。

  • 与销售、产品、服务及研发团队紧密合作，确保技术解决方案的一致性，并推动持续改进。

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder höherer Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, erneuerbaren Energien, Automatisierungstechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im technischen Support, im technischen Außendienst, in der Anwendungstechnik oder im technischen Pre-Sales, idealerweise in den Bereichen Photovoltaik, Wechselrichter, Batteriespeicher oder erneuerbare Energiesysteme.

  • Erfahrung in der Führung, im Coaching oder in der Koordination eines technischen Support- oder Serviceteams.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Photovoltaikanlagen, Wechselrichter, Batterien, elektrische Systeme, Kommunikationssysteme und Inbetriebnahme.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Eskalationen zu steuern, mehrere Fälle zu priorisieren und Probleme bis zur vollständigen Lösung zu verfolgen.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Fehlerdiagnose, Ursachenanalyse und Problemlösung.

  • Kundenorientierter Führungsstil sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholdermanagement und in der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit.

  • Souveräne Kommunikation mit Installateuren, Distributoren, EPC-Unternehmen und Geschäftskunden sowohl auf technischer als auch auf Managementebene.

  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb der DACH-Region sowie gelegentlich innerhalb Europas.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

任职要求

  • 电气工程、电子工程、可再生能源、自动化或相关技术专业本科及以上学历。

  • 具备扎实的技术支持、现场服务、应用工程或售前技术经验，具有光伏、逆变器、电池储能或可再生能源系统行业经验者优先。

  • 具备技术支持或服务团队的领导、辅导或协调经验。

  • 深入了解光伏系统、逆变器、电池、电气系统、通信系统及调试工作。

  • 具备处理升级问题、合理安排多个事项优先级，并推动问题解决闭环的能力。

  • 具备较强的故障排查、根因分析及问题解决能力。

  • 具备以客户为导向的领导风格，以及较强的相关方协调和跨部门协作能力。

  • 能够与安装商、分销商、EPC承包商及专业客户的技术人员和管理人员进行有效沟通。

  • 能够在DACH区域内出差，并接受偶尔在欧洲其他地区出差。

  • 德语流利，具备良好的英语能力；掌握中文者优先。

Über LunyOne

Willkommen bei LunyOne! Wir sind eine dynamische Influencer-Marketing-Agentur mit über 25 Mitarbeitenden in Langenfeld und fokussieren uns auf Tech, (Mobile-)Gaming, Entertainment und Lifestyle.

Mit LunyTech, unserer Unit für Consumer Electronics, bauen wir den Tech-Bereich gerade massiv aus. LunyTech betreut internationale Tech-Marken, vor allem aus China, bei ihren Influencer- und KOL-Kampagnen im DACH-Markt: von Smartphones und TVs über Audio und Smart Home bis hin zu Ergonomie und Gadgets. Dazu gehören Launch-Kampagnen, langfristige Creator-Partnerschaften und Aktivierungen auf Messen wie der IFA in Berlin und der gamescom in Köln. Neben externen Creators arbeiten wir eng mit unseren eigenen Tech-Talents zusammen und kennen die DACH-Tech-Creator-Szene von YouTube bis TikTok sehr genau.

Die meisten Entscheidungen unserer Kunden fallen im Headquarter in China. Abgestimmt wird über WeChat und Feishu/Lark, oft auf Mandarin, und genau an dieser Schnittstelle verlieren viele Agenturen Zeit und inhaltliche Schärfe. Wir wollen das ändern, mit Dir als direktem Draht zwischen den chinesischen HQs und unseren Kampagnen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Start: ab Februar 2027.

Deine Rolle

Als Campaign & Account Manager DACH mit Mandarin-Kenntnissen und Affinität zu Tech & Consumer Electronics bist Du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren chinesisch-sprachigen Kunden und unserem operativen Team in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Influencer Campaign Management

  • Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst Influencer- und KOL-Kampagnen für den DACH-Markt – von der Konzeption bis zur Auswertung.

  • Du recherchierst geeignete Creator und bewertest deren Zielgruppen, Content, Reichweite und Markenfit.

  • Du entwickelst Kampagnenbriefings und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Creators und internen Teams.

  • Du behältst Timings, Budgets, Content-Freigaben und Qualitätsstandards im Blick.

  • Du verfolgst Entwicklungen, Trends und Plattformen im Influencer Marketing und bringst relevante Erkenntnisse in unsere Arbeit ein.

2. Account Management & Kundenberatung

  • Du bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

  • Du verstehst die Ziele und Anforderungen unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in passende Influencer-Marketing-Strategien

  • Du präsentierst Kampagnenkonzepte, Ergebnisse und Handlungsempfehlungen.

  • Du sorgst für transparente Kommunikation und eine professionelle Betreuung über den gesamten Kampagnenverlauf hinweg.

3. Business Development & Marktentwicklung

  • Du unterstützt den Ausbau unserer Geschäftsbeziehungen zu chinesischen Marken, die den deutschen und europäischen Markt erschließen möchten.

  • Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und unterstützt bei Pitches und Präsentationen.

  • Du bringst Dein Verständnis des chinesischen Marktes und der dortigen Geschäftskultur ein.

  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Positionierung und unser Leistungsangebot für chinesische Kunden weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Betreuung unserer Kunden auf internationalen Branchenmessen wie der IFA Berlin und der gamescom Köln.

  • Teilnahme an regelmäßigen Kunden- und Partnerreisen.

Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt auf Influencer Campaign Management und Account Management. Business Development ist ein ergänzender Bestandteil deiner Aufgaben und bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv am Wachstum von LunyOne mitzuwirken. Das hybride Arbeiten ermöglicht Dir in enger Abstimmung mit Deinem Team effektiv zu kooperieren.

Das bringst Du mit

Must-haves

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 1,5-2 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung im Influencer- oder KOL-Marketing – beispielsweise bei einer Agentur, einer Marke oder einer Creator-Marketing-Plattform.

  • Du hast bereits an Influencer-Kampagnen mitgearbeitet und kennst die wesentlichen Abläufe von der Creator-Recherche über Briefings und Content-Koordination bis zum Reporting.

  • Du sprichst Mandarin auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst sicher mit chinesischsprachigen Kunden und Geschäftspartnern kommunizieren.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Dich in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld sicher verständigen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, baust Beziehungen auf und hast Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

  • Du interessierst Dich für Social Media, Creator Economy und die Entwicklung des Influencer-Marktes in China und Europa.

Das ist ein Plus

  • Du hast sowohl auf Agentur- als auch auf Markenseite gearbeitet.

  • Du hast bereits chinesische Marken bei ihrer internationalen Expansion unterstützt oder mit europäischen Marken zusammengearbeitet.

  • Du kennst Plattformen wie Xiaohongshu (RED) und WeChat aus einem professionellen Marketingkontext.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Präsentationen, Pitches oder Business Development mit.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse, die Dir die Zusammenarbeit mit deutschsprachigen Kunden und Partnern erleichtern.

Was Dich bei LunyOne erwartet

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und Kampagnen und kannst Deine Erfahrung aktiv einbringen.

  • Internationales Arbeiten: Du verbindest chinesische Kundenperspektiven mit der operativen Umsetzung im deutschen und europäischen Markt.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Prozesse, Kundenbeziehungen und unser Angebot mitentwickeln.

  • Wachstumsperspektive: Du wirst Teil unserer Weiterentwicklung und kannst gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen Verantwortung übernehmen.

Benefits:

  • Ein motiviertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und Raum für eigene Ideen, wo Du die Chance hast, Dich selbst zu verwirklichen und zu wachsen - wir pflegen ein familiäres Wachstum

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell (60% remote nach der Probezeit)

  • Gleitzeitmodell (Kernarbeitszeit 11:00 – 15:00 Uhr)

  • 28 Urlaubstage

  • Hochwertige technische Ausstattung mit MacBook und iPhone

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) bis max 4% der BBG (aktuell 322€/M) - 100% Zuschuss

  • 50€ monatlich über unsere LunyOne Spendit Card

  • Spendit Wellbeing

  • Erfolgsabhängige Provision zusätzlich zum Festgehalt

  • Jobauto über Gehaltsumwandlung

  • bKv (300€ Budget/Jahr)

  • Corporate Benefits

  • Relocation Bonus von 964€

  • Fortbildung/ Upskilling, bis zu ca. 1.200€ p.a.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events & -Reisen

Mission Statement

Wir verbinden Brands, Creator und Communities für echten, nachhaltigen Erfolg.

Du wirst in einem energiegeladenen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen arbeiten. Wir suchen daher eine proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität, die Teil eines beweglichen Teams sein wird, das schnell auf neue Trends reagiert.

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Sales Director, EMEA

 

This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading.

 

As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success.

 

Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers.

  • Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one.

  • Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.

  • Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition.

  • Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable.

  • Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

  • Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events.

  • Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team.

 

Requirements

 

  • 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets.

  • An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe.

  • A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results.

  • Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued.

  • Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization.

  • The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines.

  • A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance.

  • A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Based in London, or able to work from the London office.

 

Our Sales Approach

 

Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't.

 

We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one.

 

We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time.

More about Talos

 

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

  • Bonus and stock ownership

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service

  • Global offsites and team outings

  • A one-time stipend towards at-home office set-up for all employees

  • A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes.

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Donation matching up to $100 USD annually

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks
