The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing.

This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time.

  • Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding.

  • Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them.

  • Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration.

  • Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume.

  • PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or a relevant field, plus 3–5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION

  • Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

  • Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

  • Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

  • Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

  • Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked.

  • Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

  • Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

  • Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU

  • Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

  • At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

  • A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

  • Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

  • A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

  • Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

  • Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

  • Eligible to work in the Netherlands



OUR OFFER

  • A sustainably-conscious employer;

  • Travel allowance

  • 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

  • Relocation support

  • A good pension plan;

  • A competitive salary;

  • 8% holiday pay;

  • And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

  • Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

  • Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision.  KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, age, disability, neurodiversity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen.

Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer.

Wat je gaat doen

Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen.

Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg.

Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

·       Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

·       Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie;

·       Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel;

·       Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden;

·       Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen;

·       Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam;

·       Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde.


Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

·       Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort;

·       Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering;

·       Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij;

·       Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego;

·       Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT;

·       Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg;

·       Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur;

·       Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;

·       Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

·       Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

·       Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

·       Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

·       Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers;

·       Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

·       Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

·       Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

·       Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

·       Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

·       Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team.

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt.

Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil.

Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices.

Voel jij een “ja”?

MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

  • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

Financial Control

Business Control & Business Partnering

  • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

  • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

  • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

  • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

  • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

  • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


Wie zoeken wij?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer:

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

About DataSnipper

Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI.

More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running.

Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution.


The Role


Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with.

As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models.

This is an entrepreneurial, quota-carrying role with a broad remit and room to build. You will report to the Global Partnerships Leader and work closely with our EMEA Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.


What You Will Work On

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners across Europe, including consulting firms, technology platforms, and regional networks, and act as their senior counterpart at DataSnipper.

What You Bring

How You Work

About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Licensing & entitlements: seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve users and global enterprise contracts alike.

  • Metering & billing: real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how.

  • Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly.

  • Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly.

  • Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: accurate metering, enforced entitlements, reliable billing, all observable, secure and auditable.

  • Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design.

  • Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users.

  • Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models.

  • Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI.

  • Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

  • An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams

  • Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

  • Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters

  • Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

  • Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic harnesses, and a team that is measurably better for using them

  • A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset: you shape direction, not just execute it

Nice to Have

  • Usage-, metered- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution

  • Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe), CRM and ERP integrations

  • Identity and provisioning: SSO, SCIM, multi-tenant account models

  • Product-led growth: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades

  • Financial correctness: idempotency, reconciliation, auditability, revenue recognition

  • Python, Azure and observability tooling

  • Scale-up experience, ideally in fintech or audit tech

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

Mission of this role

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

  • Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

  • Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

  • Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

  • Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

  • Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

  • Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

  • You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

  • You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

  • You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

  • You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence.

Nice to haves

  • Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines).

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

As a DevOps Engineer you'll take ownership of our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, system reliability, observability and scalability. You bring strong DevOps fundamentals paired with solid software development skills, so you can build clean, maintainable automation and internal tooling. You're comfortable operating with autonomy, making architectural decisions and raising the quality and resilience of our delivery and operational workflows.

What you'll do

  • Own infrastructure system health, security posture and cost for Rentman and Crewzone.

  • Lead the transition to fully code-defined infrastructure, moving our AWS estate from ClickOps to end-to-end Infrastructure-as-Code.

  • Set up and maintain staging environments the P&D team can rely on for daily testing.

  • Build and own our observability stack: monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerts and uptime KPIs.

  • Produce insight into hosting cost and performance, and turn that insight into concrete recommendations.

  • Unify our Fargate and Kubernetes services onto one standard.

  • Own cloud security and IAM, including account structure, access management, secrets and the controls that support our compliance work.

  • Manage stakeholders across P&D and stay ahead of infrastructure required to land future products on.

What we are looking for

  • Experience being responsible for the availability and infrastructure of a business critical product or service.

  • You've personally led an Infrastructure-as-Code migration of a non-trivial production AWS estate, using Terraform, Pulumi or CDK. Contributing to one isn't enough, we need someone who has led it.

  • You've designed and operated CI/CD pipelines at product scale, using GitHub Actions or a comparable tool. Again, designing and operating, not just maintaining.

  • You're comfortable setting your own priorities against outcomes rather than working off a ticket list.

  • You can write code, not just think about infrastructure. Some of our internal tooling depends on this.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with security testing.

  • Experience setting up test automation at scale.

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30-45 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)


Apply now! For questions or additional information, contact us at

Mission of this role

As our Senior Frontend Developer in the Customer Lifecycle Team you get new customers to the value of Rentman as quickly and enjoyably as possible. You own the journey from "I just created my account" to daily reliance, making sure that within a tight window (a customer's first big event might be two weeks out), users go from first login to confidently running their operations in the software. You focus on ease-of-use, fast implementation, and engagement, so that getting started feels effortless rather than something to dread.

Our front-end is an Angular-based SPA with over 3,500 components, built on a custom-made design system with our main data-views powered by AG-Grid. Your mission is to help keep this codebase modern and best-in-class: we strive to stay on the cutting edge, typically migrating to the latest Angular versions within two weeks of release. Maintaining that pace, while keeping the experience fast, intuitive, and effortless for our users, is central to what this role is about.

  • Remove every unnecessary obstacle between a new customer and their first successful project.

For us, having Angular experience is a nice-to-have. At Rentman, we believe that every good developer understands that a framework is a tool to help achieve results and that you can always learn a new framework if you have strong fundamentals.

About the role

Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites!

As we scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel production, secure and reliable connectivity between our IT and operational environments becomes increasingly critical. We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites.

This is a hands-on role with real influence over how our network landscape develops, from routing, switching and Wi-Fi to firewalls, IT/OT segmentation, and secure remote access.

Reporting to the IT Operations & Infrastructure Manager, the role works closely with IT, security, plant engineering, and automation partners.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate IT and OT network infrastructure at headquarters and production sites, from Purdue Level 3 upward and at the boundary with plant control systems

  • Manage and optimize our Fortinet (IT) and Palo Alto (OT) firewall environments, including rule sets, segmentation, and the industrial DMZ

  • Operate Cisco Catalyst switching and Meraki wireless at our production sites, alongside the office network at headquarters

  • Implement and maintain secure remote access for employees and vendors, including zero trust access

  • Deploy and operate Nozomi Networks for OT asset visibility and threat detection, and integrate network and OT logs into our SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel)

  • Support incident response together with our security team and managed SOC provider, and contribute to NIS2 compliance activities

This is an opportunity to build an IT/OT network from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy landscape. You will work with a modern technology stack, have real influence over architecture decisions, and see the direct impact of your work on our operational reliability and cybersecurity maturity.

The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, including hands-on responsibility for enterprise firewall environments

  • Strong experience with Fortinet FortiGate or Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and the willingness to master the other

  • Solid knowledge of routing, switching (preferably Cisco Catalyst), wireless, VPN technologies, and network security best practices

  • Experience with, or strong knowledge of, OT and industrial network environments, including ICS and SCADA systems

  • Understanding of IT/OT segmentation principles and frameworks such as IEC 62443 and the Purdue Model, including industrial DMZ design

  • Experience with OT monitoring solutions, preferably Nozomi Networks or comparable platforms such as Claroty or Dragos

  • Comfortable working in both office and plant environments, including regular travel to production sites

  • Professional proficiency in English

Nice-to-haves:

  • Certifications such as Fortinet FCP (NSE 4+), Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Cisco CCNP, Nozomi Networks, IEC 62443, or GICSP

  • Experience within the process industry, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or another industrial environment

  • Familiarity with NIS2 and experience translating regulatory requirements into practical technical controls

  • Experience with zero trust network access (such as Zscaler) and Microsoft Azure networking

  • Experience integrating network and OT logs into a SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel

  • Automation or scripting experience with Python or Ansible, and Git-based workflows

  • Experience working with EPC contractors or automation vendors during plant construction and commissioning

  • Dutch language skills

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01

As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?"

You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

  • Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies

  • Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system

  • Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective

  • Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system

  • Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques

  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions

  • Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance

  • Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions.

You recognize yourself in the following:

Must have

  • Fluent in Dutch and English

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical)

  • 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management

  • Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development

  • Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS

Preferred

  • Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG

  • Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation

  • Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring

  • Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management

About DSL-01

DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products.

DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel.

Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future.

Environmental and social responsibility are at the heart of DSL-01. We follow international frameworks and Dutch regulations to manage impacts on people, nature, and local communities. Safety, sustainability, and collaboration guide everything we do.

 

What we offer

As DSL-01 is still being built, many aspects of the plant, roles, and benefits are still being shaped. Our HR team is actively defining the full compensation and benefits package specifically for the Delfzijl facility. You can be assured that the final offer will be highly competitive and designed to reward your expertise, contribution, and impact as we bring this pioneering SAF plant to life.

We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth.

 

Is this you?

At DSL-01, you will work in a dynamic, innovative environment where technical curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork are valued. You will engage with operators, engineers, and managers across disciplines, helping to bring a pioneering renewable fuels facility to life while making a real impact on the planet.

Are you ready to help build a plant from the ground up? Join a pioneering force in sustainable aviation and help create a cleaner, more sustainable future.

For more information about DSL-01 (part of the SkyNRG) visit www.SkyNRG.com.

Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

 

Over de functie

Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie.

Voor de start van de fabriek:

  • Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

  • Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven.

 

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

  • Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring

  • Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie.

  • Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing.

  • Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

  • Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact.

The challenge 

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities include: 

  • Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control.

  • System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS.

  • Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments.

  • Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

  • Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

  • Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements.

  • Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

  • Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

Required Skills and Competencies:

Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden.

Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team

  • Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering.

  • Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd.

  • Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft.

  • Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam

  • Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

  • Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden.

  • Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren.

  • Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur.

  • Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen.

  • Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B.

Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden.

  • Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek.

  • Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team.

  • Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren.

We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost.

Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen.

Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen?

Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam.

Compensation: €4K – €6K per month

Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations?

At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies.

As a PLC Software Engineer, you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions.


Why this role?

You’ll get the opportunity to:

  • Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning;

  • Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants;

  • Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone;

  • Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise;

  • Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites;

  • Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home;

  • Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition.

What will you do?

As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction.

You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.

Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems;

  • Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies;

  • Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning;

  • Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation;

  • Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations;

  • Implementing software updates and optimizations;

  • Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions;

  • Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts;

  • Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines;

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team.


What do you bring?

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work.

Ideally, you have:

  • A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field;

  • Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment;

  • Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions.

  • Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations;

  • A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems;

  • Good command of English, both spoken and written;

  • Knowledge of OT security is a plus.

What’s in it for you?

We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work.

You can expect:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background;

  • The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week;

  • Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ;

  • Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office;

  • An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service;

  • An excellent pension scheme;

  • 8% annual holiday allowance;

  • A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions;

  • A high level of autonomy and responsibility;

  • Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development;

  • An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers;

  • The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition;

  • A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work;

  • A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo.

About Bright Renewables

Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse.

We are part of HoSt Group, a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology.

For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company.

Interested?

We’d like to get to know you.

Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview.

Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work?

Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80.

Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy.

Who are we?

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence.

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses.

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary and annual bonus linked to your performance / OKRs

  • Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc. 

  • Flexible hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office 

  • Healthy work-life balance allowing for planability and personal commitments 

  • Chance to grow with the company gaining increasing responsibilities, supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach 

  • Tremendous learning and career progression opportunities 

  • International environment with hubs in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore

  • Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence and a fun working atmosphere with regular outings and events 

  • Post product-market fit and aspiring unicorn status - this is an excellent time to join & grow with us!

Does this sound like a perfect match?

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of? Click ‘Apply’ and submit your CV, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

Your personal data will be processed for the purpose of conducting a recruitment process for the job position you apply for. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

As a Solutions Engineer I in the Connect team, you'll support the partners who bring processing volume to Mollie, think SaaS platforms and marketplaces. Your core activities are discovery, solution design, and implementation support for partner deals, the work that turns a promising conversation into a working integration.

Beyond the deal itself, you'll join forecasting meetings with the Connect leadership team to give an honest, objective view of technical deal health, and you'll have regular one-on-ones with the partner acquisition managers you support to align on deal details and next steps. You'll also support events and pitches for the commercial team and contribute to process improvement and internal product feedback, so the lessons from one deal make the next one easier.

Solutions Engineers are the bridge between technical and commercial teams at Mollie. Strong discovery means partners get solutions that actually fit, pricing negotiations become smoother, and partner needs and product issues make their way back into the business. That's a direct line to how Mollie expands into new products and partner segments.

What you'll ship

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand and map complex merchant requirements.

  • Design and present tailored payment solutions, clearly mapping Mollie’s APIs and products to specific business needs.

  • Build and deliver custom demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that prove our value.

  • Act as the technical expert in the room, partnering with Account Executives to overcome objections and close strategic deals.

  • Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering teams, channeling critical merchant feedback to help shape our product roadmap.

What you'll bring

  • 2 to 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technical role.

  • Customer-facing experience with a technical product, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical customer success

  • Comfortable working with APIs, with the ability to demo and build solutions on top of them

  • Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product

  • Ability to explain a complex product, including payment methods, sub-products, and the Connect proposition, to both technical and commercial audiences

  • Experience working with both internal and external senior executives stakeholders
